disposal_tips: Rigid bottles, jugs, and tubs (PET #1, HDPE #2, PP #5) are widely recyclable.
Avoid placing soft plastic bags, bubble wrap, or styrofoam in curbside recycling.
Do not bag recyclables—place items loose into the recycling bin.
prep_steps: Empty and rinse out any remaining liquid or food residue.
Remove non-recyclable film wraps or pumps if attached.
Keep plastic caps screwed on tightly if accepted by your local facility.
